## Review checklist

- [ ] Design review was completed before implementation, or this change has no design impact.
- [ ] Security review was completed for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Relevant unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when needed.
- [ ] Accessibility impact was reviewed when applicable.
- [ ] If this change is being released, the release performance smoke test is expected to pass.
